new.statement: Everyday-device games (phone repair, phone drop tests, a simulated iPad) are a short wave: they break onto Up-and-Coming and Top Trending fast but the curiosity-only ones fall within two weeks
new.rationale: Fix My Phone! entered Up-and-Coming at 15 days and Realistic Phone Drop Test rose 41 on Top Trending, while Apple iPad Original fell 39 on Top Trending and 34 on Up-and-Coming at 11 days. Tracking these three for another week, plus any new device-themed entries, would show whether depth (a repair shop) separates the survivors from the novelty ones.

qualitative_updates.note: Backseat Rally entered Most Popular at 15 days and is among the best on Up-and-Coming; Rally Panic! is again among the weakest Top Trending movers. One clear winner per wave so far.

Fix My Phone! (hand-repair steps, 'SO SATISFYING' thumbnail) entered Up-and-Coming at 15 days with 47K favorites; Wash the Car fell 19 on Up-and-Coming. The verb still needs a shop/progression layer to last.
Steal Animal Egg and Steal ASMR! fell off Most Popular and Kick a Lucky Block fell 16, while Steal An Egg stays the best game on the pillar.
Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) is among the best Top Trending movers at 11 days; Sell Fries! [Anomaly] is among the weakest on Top Earning efficiency, consistent with reach before revenue.
tt→mp (75, median 2 days) and uc→tt (72, 2 days) remain the dominant transitions; tt→uc is almost absent (1).
